versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
A gold tribe in two halves: the Hive grows when you end the turn with gold saved, the Carnival grows when you spend a lot in one turn.
You alternate saving turns and big-spending turns, and a few units let one turn do both.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Every unit now prints its Hive or Carnival tag, and Tithonus and Signora Afide say exactly what they do.
Maestro Tettix no longer turns a turn of Refreshes into a free Splurge, and the Long-Dark Nymph also grows when you Tier up.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
